name: Catherine Stefani

items.text: In 2019 Stefani, then a San Francisco supervisor, took over the Maya Angelou monument project. She rejected the artist panel's top pick, a bronze book by Lava Thomas, because she wanted a traditional statue. The process restarted. In 2020 she apologized, saying "My actions hurt and angered people, and I understand why." Thomas's design was later approved.
items.why: This was a disagreement over art design by the legislation's sponsor, with no abuse of office, self-dealing or false statement about her record, so it bears on none of the criteria.

for_review: The Wikipedia quote about elevating women 'in the same way that men have been historically elevated' is attributed to the SF Examiner. The Examiner page could not be opened, so I did not use the quote. The SF Chronicle column I read is an opinion column, but it reports the facts of the episode and Stefani's apology. The search on the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) turned up nothing about Stefani or this item. I did not look for other controversies, because the search budget was used on this item.
